notes.title: Let's talk
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40565061/643c11ce2210f0bbd5120012b9561f5c4e908ad2.png[/img]

Thank you for playing Nemezis: Mysterious Journey III Prologue and sharing reviews! Thank you for reporting bugs!

Feedback from players is crucial for game development. Share it with us! To make it easier you can [b]just answer some of these questions:[/b]
[list]
[*] What was your favorite and your least favorite moment or interaction? 
[*] When did you feel the most clever?
[*] Was there anything you wanted to do that the game wouldn't let you do?
[*] If you had a magic wand and could change any aspect of the game or your experience, what would it be? 
[/list]

notes.title: Birds of (Regilus) Paradise – Contest Announcement!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40565061/0d42f379b1a45bf608a5090730800dbe76f41153.png[/img]

[b]Why so many birds on Regilus?[/b]

At first, there were to be no animals on Regilus. We wanted to focus on vegetation. But one day our lead graphic designer, Robert (hi, Robert! We love you!), asked if he could add one or two birds to the game. 

We thought: why not? One or two birds? Cool! 

And... that's how it started. The birds took over the first level of the game (which you can enjoy in 
Nemezis: Mysterious Journey III Prologue. They were both here and there. Here, there, here and there. It was slowly starting to resemble The Birds by Alfred Hitchcock. We said: please, stop! 

But... Robert's vision became slightly hazy and he was repeating: Just. One. More. Tiny. Bird... Just one more…

It took us a while, but we got the situation under control. As you can see, there aren't THAT many birds in the Prologue. That's right! [b]How MANY are there? Who can find them all?[/b] Write your answers in the comments below the post!

Those who manage to do so will be rewarded with a free game of [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/986350/Nemezis_Mysterious_Journey_III/][b]Nemezis: Mysterious Journey III[/b][/url] (to be released on July 8!). You have time till the premiere of the game. So - happy birds watching!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40565061/6b6756e94c1a028c81fa9d08f834bb788e5d8042.gif[/img]

notes.title: The prologue premiere postponed
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40565061/8f588b6ce778748eae1e37a4907c23457cb59e15.png[/img]

Hello, Players!

As you know, today the free prologue to the PC version of the game Nemezis: Mysterious Journey III was to be released, [b]but there were some slight changes.[/b]

As Detalion Games, we would like to assure you that [b]the production of the prologue is complete and ready for release[/b], however, the release of the game on Steam requires additional Distributor approval, which [b]should happen in the coming days.[/b]

Please give us a little more time and don't forget to add it to your wishlist!
